'''Fellwater''' was a laboratory that was destroyed in the [[Destruction of Taris|bombardment]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in [[3956 BBY]]. [[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] later, the acidic [[Lake Brell]] sat over the ruins of Fellwater Labs. Around [[3642 BBY]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] completely [[Invasion of Taris|invaded]] Taris and had the [[Toxic Lake Garrison]] nearby. They had infantry patrolling near Fellwater, meaning this could be tied with the disappearance of the [[Lake Brell colony]].
